_comment: Pinned inputs for the v2 dataset pipeline (docs/DATASET.md §2). Paths are as seen inside the build container (/app = the app tree, /work = ~/sites/base/yaab-data).

coreRules._comment: Core-rule glossary (Deep Strike, Deadly Demise X, Lethal Hits, ...). GDC prints core abilities and weapon keywords by NAME only, so their rule text has no GDC source. One-time snapshot of the 72 faction=='core' entries of the v1 build/abilities-index.json, frozen as a pinned file. Generic rules, not per-unit text; no other v1 store content is used.

abilityIndex._comment: Pinned v1 40kdc ability-text index (keys: ability slug, or <faction>/<slug>). Fallback text for GDC name-only faction abilities and the 40kdc-only Legends sheets, after GDC's own rules (owner ruling 2026-10-31).
